query.description: Agent Company Reference ID for filtering (optional, 0 = no filter)

request.description:
Select all agents for a specific company with optional filtering by agent company

Parameters:
- companyRefId: Company ID (required, > 0)
- jobId: Agent company ID for filtering (optional, 0 = no filter)

Returns:
- ok: true/false
- message: Response message
- data: List of agents (filtered by Active != 2, sorted by name)
- count: Total number of agents returned
- error: Error message (null on success)

item.name: GetActiveAddresses - Get All Active Addresses for Company

request.description: Get all active addresses (active != 2) for a specific company. Returns addresses sorted by name. Requires valid JWT token with role ROLE_SUPERADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, or ROLE_100

query.description: Optional search keyword - searches address names containing this text (case-insensitive)

request.description: Search for active addresses by company and keyword. If keyword is empty, returns all active addresses. Filters: active != 2. Returns addresses sorted by name. Requires valid JWT token

item.name: SelectEmployeeAll - Get All Active Employees for Company

query.description: Optional employee type filter. If empty, 'ALL', or not provided, returns all employees

request.description: Get all active employees for a specific company with optional employee type filter. Returns all employees (excluding Active=2) ordered by employee name with their account information. Equivalent to .NET SelectEmployeeAll method. Requires valid JWT token with appropriate role
